_why: tile_source: tile index -> model image to take it from. detail: tiles drawn together on an 8x sheet and taken from it. objects: single-tile pickups cut out of their tiles, drawn alone at 24x on the key colour and pasted onto their background last; drawn as part of a tile their round edges were clipped and stepped at tile borders, and at 4x the model guessed letters (R as A, n, B) and mixed styles. mask_from: 664 is the R coin set in dirt, so it borrows the plain R's (660) outline.
